definitions.explanation: An unfair, preconceived opinion not based on reason or experience. A one-sided view formed without consideration of all facts.

examples.japanese: {偏見|へんけん}を{持|も}たずに{判断|はんだん}する。
{人種|じんしゅ}に{対|たい}する{偏見|へんけん}をなくす。
{偏見|へんけん}の{目|め}で{見|み}られた。
examples.english: I was looked at with prejudiced eyes.

notes:
{偏見|へんけん} combines {偏|へん} (biased, one-sided) and {見|けん} (view).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {偏見|へんけん}を{持|も}つ: to have prejudice
- {偏見|へんけん}をなくす: to eliminate prejudice
- {偏見|へんけん}の{目|め}で{見|み}る: to look at with prejudiced eyes
- {偏見|へんけん}に{満|み}ちた: full of prejudice

CONTRAST:
- {先入観|せんにゅうかん}: preconception (more neutral)
- {差別|さべつ}: discrimination (action, not just attitude)
- {固定観念|こていかんねん}: fixed idea, stereotype
